title: Penthouse Magazine January 1990 Stephanie Page Pet of the Year
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, January 1990 issue — Special Holiday Edition, Pet of the Year, featuring Stephanie Page. Also includes "Naval Maneuvers" (U.S.S. Iowa cover-up investigation), "The New Decade" retrospective, and Sicily's Mafia feature.
Has a torn/chipped corner on the front cover (see photos); otherwise complete, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
